These can only pass once the generator authors the document, matching the same pre-implementation-fails posture verified for sibling contracts 085 and 092.

Dry-ran the enum-lock check (verification[11]) against a novel probe of my own design, not among the ten shapes the validator exercised across revisions 1-3 (per-row table cell, comma list, standalone proposal sentence, heading, quoted-JSON token, line-shared-with-lock-sentence, etc.): a Sec 6 that is otherwise fully compliant (cites `schema/feature_list.schema.json` and all five backticked status tokens, carries the exact unbroken lock sentence 'no `done` state exists and none may be added') PLUS one additional sentence elsewhere in Sec 6 that documents, for a reader, how the backticked token would be typeset using proper Markdown double-backtick code-span escaping to display a literal backtick character: `` `done` ``. Ran the contract's actual verification[11] command body (unmodified) against this fixture. Result: the check correctly FAILED with 'backticked `done` token found outside the doctrinal lock sentence', because the check performs a raw-text substring scan for the literal three-character sequence backtick-d-o-n-e-backtick and is not markdown-aware -- the double-backtick code-span delimiters surrounding the mention do not shield the inner single-backtick-quoted substring from the scan. This behavior is CONSISTENT with the contract's own declared catch set (design_notes.feature_done_enum_lock_assertion, revision 3: 'any backticked `done` in ANY shape ... appearing anywhere in the document outside the lock-sentence substring', explicitly 'or any other markdown construct'); it is not enumerated among the shapes the validator's own ten dry-runs exercised, but the declared catch set is explicitly shape-agnostic rather than an enumerated whitelist, so an unenumerated shape being caught is expected behavior, not a mismatch. No finding raised from this probe. (Note for the generator, non-blocking: this means a compliant document must avoid using double-backtick-escaped display of the literal `done` token anywhere outside the exact lock sentence, including in any explanatory aside about the token's own typesetting -- the check will treat such an aside identically to a real enum-row violation.)

Residual, non-blocking note (not raised as an unsupported_claim under the executability lens this review applies, since it is a prescriptive build instruction for the generator rather than a factual claim the contract asserts about present repo state): design_notes.frontmatter_pin commits the new document's own change_log to 'Exactly one entry, version 0.1.0 ... summarizing the initial authoring', but no verification entry independently checks that shape on standard/definition_of_done.md itself -- unlike standard/README.md's change_log, which verification[6] explicitly checks for version/entry pairing. Checked schema/frontmatter.schema.json directly: change_log is an optional key with no entry-count or version-match constraint, and C1 (frontmatter-schema, exercised via verification[1]/[2]) validates only the six required keys, so a missing, extra, or mis-versioned change_log entry on the new document would not be caught by any listed verification command. This is a genuine but narrow gap left to Mode B's post-code `git diff HEAD` review rather than to this contract's own checks; flagging it as an observation rather than a blocking finding because it concerns forward-looking authoring guidance (Mode A/spec-alignment territory this review is instructed to spot-check, not re-litigate exhaustively) rather than an executability defect in any listed command.

No non_goals entry, hard_style_rule, or verification-array wording forbids an evaluator-originated adversarial check outside this contract's own eighteen listed commands; the Loop-2 QA round remains free to add one adversarial probe of its own choosing per methodology/02_adversarial_tdd.md Section 6 without contradicting this contract's stated scope.

final_verdict.summary: APPROVED at revision 3 (post round-4 Mode A approval), independently re-verified from the evaluator's executability lens. All 18 verification entries are deterministic, run from the repo root with no network dependency, and depend only on bash/git/grep/sed/awk/python3 (+jsonschema, +yaml), all present in this environment; none reference an out-of-repo fixture or credential. The 18 entries jointly cover all five feature-093 acceptance tests from .agent/feature_list_013.json verbatim (verification[1]/[2] -> AT1, [3] -> AT2, [4]/[5] -> AT3, [7] -> AT4, [8]/[9] -> AT5), with the remainder strengthening coverage (per-check discrimination, NIZAM.json registration-shape membership, README version/change_log pairing, 13-section structural completeness, the enum-lock structural rewrite, the guide-card sentence and C10-anchor-safety guards, the CHANGELOG entry, the feature-list/run-state non-content-touch carve-out, and the full-sweep plus e2e-bootstrap non-regression proofs) rather than inventing unrelated criteria. Sanity-ran seven of the eighteen commands directly against the live pre-implementation tree at base_revision 818919f (matching current HEAD): the schema self-check, both SHA-anchored guards, the h3-uniqueness precondition, the full validate.sh sweep baseline (16 passed, 0 failed, confirming C16 already active), fixtures_self_test.sh and e2e_bootstrap_test.sh (both PASS as general regression guards), and confirmed the file-existence-dependent checks genuinely fail pre-implementation as required. Dry-ran the enum-lock check (verification[11]) against one novel, evaluator-designed probe outside the validator's own ten dry-run shapes -- a double-backtick Markdown code-span display of the literal `done` token inside an otherwise-compliant Sec 6 -- and confirmed the check correctly rejects it, consistent with the contract's declared shape-agnostic catch set; no mismatch found. One narrow, non-blocking authoring-guidance gap noted in observations (the new document's own change_log shape is not independently re-verified by any listed command) but left as Mode B's concern rather than a blocking finding, since it is a prescriptive build detail rather than an executability defect. Evidence-plan convention (.agent/evidence/093/, Sec-5 shape) is workable for all 18 commands including the enum-lock structural check. Cleared to proceed to implementation.
